pageSpec.rendering: Server page entry + hydrated Client Components
pageSpec.revalidation: No explicit ISR interval or route revalidation configured. Static shell eligibility inferred from source; deployment rendering not verified.
pageSpec.dataLoading: Workspace data loads client-side after mount; no server-side workspace fetch in page.tsx.

Components.name: Page → Workspace
Components.detail: Server page composes the client entry. No props passed.

Components.name: Workspace → WorkspaceSession
Components.detail: Props: actor:string, setActor callback. key={actor} remounts the session and resets its state when identity changes.

Components.name: WorkspaceSession → AssignmentDetail
Components.detail: Props: assignment, data, actor, refresh, onClose. Rendered for the selected assignment. Owns comments, comment draft, busy and error state.

Components.name: WorkspaceSession → CreateAssignment
Components.detail: Props: data, actor, onClose, onDone. Shown when creating is true. Submission refreshes workspace data.

Permissions.name: Complete / start assignment
Permissions.detail: Server-provided canComplete / canStart disable actions; completeReason / startReason explain why. busy also disables action. Backend rechecks authorization and state.

Permissions.name: Create and assign
Permissions.detail: workspaceViewer.canCreate gates New assignment. canManage controls available assignees in the creation form.

Permissions.name: Comment
Permissions.detail: assignment.capabilities.canComment disables editor and submit. Busy and an empty body also disable submission.

API & triggers.name: Mount / filter change → Workspace query → data
API & triggers.detail: actor, projectId, status or search change schedules a query after 100ms. Previous effect aborts. In-flight refreshes coalesce into one follow-up.

API & triggers.name: Complete / Start click → mutation → refresh
API & triggers.detail: Set busy; send id; on success refetch workspace; surface actionError on failure; clear busy in finally. No optimistic update.

API & triggers.name: Open detail / data change → Comments query
API & triggers.detail: Effect depends on actor, assignment.id and data. Cleanup aborts the previous request.

API & triggers.name: Submit forms → Create / Comment → refresh
API & triggers.detail: Mutations run on submission. Comment clears its draft after success. Creation invokes onDone. Requests POST to /graphql through the Next.js rewrite.

State & cache.name: Local state ownership
State & cache.detail: Workspace owns actor. WorkspaceSession owns project, status, search, selected, creating, busy, actionError and inspect. Filters are local, not URL state.

State & cache.name: Remote data in React state
State & cache.detail: useWorkspace owns data, error, connection and lastEvent. Custom fetch hook; no React Query / SWR cache or persisted browser store here.

State & cache.name: Next.js vs backend cache
State & cache.detail: No explicit Next.js data-cache policy for workspace data: browser POST requests load it. Dashboard Redis caching is a separate backend concern; organization and permission scope must remain isolated.

Realtime.name: Actor → connection → WorkspaceChanges
Realtime.detail: graphql-ws connects with demo actor parameters. One subscription per hook instance; recreated when actor changes. Infinite retry attempts configured.

Realtime.name: Event / window focus → 200ms coalescing → refresh
Realtime.detail: Event kind updates lastEvent. Notifications trigger a query rather than patching records. Reconnection recovery depends on server subscription readiness events; this hook has no durable replay.

Realtime.name: Unmount / actor switch → cleanup
Realtime.detail: Clear timer, remove focus listener, unsubscribe and dispose socket. Query effect aborts old HTTP request. Connection UI reports Connected / Reconnecting / Unavailable.

States & failures.name: Loading / error / empty / busy
States & failures.detail: Hook starts with null data and exposes error. Components render pending and empty states. Mutations surface errors and clear busy in finally; no optimistic rollback needed.

States & failures.name: Identity boundary
States & failures.detail: Changing actor remounts WorkspaceSession, clearing drafts, selection and data. Demo identities are spoofable; these are not production authentication controls.

Browser storage.name: localStorage / sessionStorage: not used
Browser storage.detail: Workspace uses memory-only React state. Actor, filters, selection and drafts reset on reload; no storage keys, expiry or cross-tab storage listeners. The separate Model Studio persists its diagram model in localStorage; that is not workspace page behavior.

pageSpec.rendering: Server page entry + client OrdersLab; business data fetched after mount
pageSpec.revalidation: No explicit ISR interval. Browser GraphQL requests use cache: no-store.
pageSpec.dataLoading: Two independent effects fetch demo identities and orders. No server data fetch in the page entry.

Components.name: Page → OrdersLab
Components.detail: No props. OrdersLab owns controls, table, create form, response inspector, and learning notes in one file.

Permissions.name: Create / cancel / field selection
Permissions.detail: viewer.canCreate shows creation form. cancel.authorized controls button presence; cancel.available and busy disable it; reason explains restrictions. Selecting total requests a field, not permission to read it.

API & triggers.name: Mount / retry → demo identities
API & triggers.detail: DEMO_USERS runs on mount and identityRetry changes. Cleanup aborts the request.

API & triggers.name: Actor / selected fields / refresh → orders query
API & triggers.detail: Effect depends on query, actor and revision. includeTotal changes the generated document. Cleanup aborts stale requests.

API & triggers.name: Create / cancel → mutation → refetch
API & triggers.detail: runMutation sets busy, records the response, and refetches only when the GraphQL envelope has no errors. No optimistic update.

State & cache.name: Local state + uncached requests
State & cache.detail: actor, includeTotal, identities, result, revision, busy, error, mutation, title and identityRetry live in OrdersLab React state. No query cache library. graphqlRequest explicitly sets no-store.

Browser storage.name: localStorage / sessionStorage: not used
Browser storage.detail: No browser storage reads or writes in this page. Identity, selected fields and form draft reset on remount/reload. No keys, TTL, migration or cross-tab storage listeners.

States & failures.name: HTTP and GraphQL errors
States & failures.detail: HTTP 200 can contain GraphQL errors. The client preserves the envelope for inspection. Mutation refresh is skipped on GraphQL errors; busy resets in finally. Aborted effects do not show errors.

pageSpec.rendering: Server Component with static content; no page-owned Client Component
pageSpec.revalidation: No data fetching or explicit revalidation policy. Static-render eligibility inferred from source, not verified against deployment output.
pageSpec.dataLoading: Content is defined in the route file. No page-owned API requests.

Components.name: Guide → static content + navigation
Components.detail: One server component renders the learning guide and a Next.js Link to /. No business props or client state.

State & cache.name: Static content
State & cache.detail: No page-owned React state or remote-data cache. Updating the guide requires changing source and rebuilding.

Browser storage.name: localStorage / sessionStorage: not used
Browser storage.detail: This page does not persist browser data. No keys, expiry, hydration synchronization or storage event listeners.
